name: Grace [GRACE BUT EVIL]
desc:
// !! GAME IS IN ALPHA !! \\
EVERYTHING IS BOUND TO CHANGE, EVEN LORE.

it might seem like it's just suffering, but you wouldn't be here if I didn't embrace you.
A Rooms game with a focus on chaos, movement and speed.
Tredge from saferoom to saferoom, don't let your time run out.

Lobby music by Joseph Burdock

Headphones, +6 graphics, PC recommended.
Game is designed to be played without audio too, but we still recommend it.

The game is mostly made by one person. Excuse lack of quality in the stuff I lack in.

Inspired by "Rooms" by nicorocks5555, "Rooms & Doors" by CJ4 (best rooms game), "DOORS" by LSPLASH, "Pressure" by Urbanshade, "Pizza Tower" by Tour De Pizza, "Mandela Catalogue" by Alex Kister, "Inscryption" by Daniel Mullins, "FAITH" by Airdorf Games and The Bible.
